mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, thread_uuid, thread_external_id, event_type, payload, processed_at, created_at, deleted_at
uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, thread_uuid, thread_external_id, event_type, payload, processed_at, created_at
mapper.select: WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO session_events () VALUES () ON CONFLICT (workspace_uuid, external_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING ) SELECT FROM inserted

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE( e.payload->>'tool_use_id', e.payload->>'mcp_tool_use_id', e.payload->>'custom_tool_use_id', e.payload->>'id' ) AS tool_use_id FROM session_events e JOIN session_threads t ON t.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND t.session_uuid = e.session_uuid AND t.uuid = e.thread_uuid AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE e.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND e.session_external_id = #{sessionExternalID} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.parent_thread_uuid IS NOT NULL AND e.event_type IN #{eventType} AND COALESCE( e.payload->>'tool_use_id', e.payload->>'mcp_tool_use_id', e.payload->>'custom_tool_use_id', e.payload->>'id' ) IN #{toolUseID}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM session_events event JOIN session_resources resource ON resource.workspace_uuid = event.workspace_uuid AND resource.session_external_id = event.session_external_id AND resource.external_id = #{resourceExternalID} AND resource.resource_type = 'file' AND resource.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN files file ON file.workspace_uuid = resource.workspace_uuid AND file.uuid = resource.file_uuid AND file.deleted_at IS NULL CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(event.payload->'content') = 'array' THEN event.payload->'content' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) content_block WHERE event.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND event.session_external_id = #{sessionExternalID} AND event.event_type = 'user.message' AND event.deleted_at IS NULL AND content_block->>'type' IN ('document', 'image') AND content_block->'source'->>'type' = 'file' AND content_block->'source'->>'file_id' = file.external_id )
